title: DeskAgentMissedReminderSummary
description: Data payload for the separate notification.summary.deliver SDK application command approved by CR-028.

summary_id.description: Stable globally unique notification idempotency key; unchanged across retries and recovery of the same batch.

batch_id.description: Stable persisted identity of one recovery scan batch.

created_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp at which the immutable summary outbox item was created.

expires_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp exactly 24 hours after created_at.

scheduled_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 scheduled time; items are ordered by this value ascending.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of this reminder, retained as canonical timezone metadata.

display_time.description: Host-formatted local date and time with explicit UTC offset, e.g. 2035-01-01 18:00 UTC+08:00. It is display-only and must correspond to scheduled_at and timezone.

omitted_count.description: Exact number of additional eligible occurrences omitted because items is capped at 20.
